reason: The cited evidence (E1, E2) demonstrates that a 2100°C homogenization treatment produces a homogeneous BCC phase and high strength in HfMoNbTaW alloys, but it does not provide any data on TiVNbTa. The key premises about segregation reduction, phase stabilization, and strength enhancement in TiVNbTa are therefore unsupported by the cited passages, and the analogy between the alloy systems is assumed rather than evidenced.
premises: Homogenization at ~2100°C reduces dendritic segregation in TiVNbTa
Reduced segregation stabilizes a uniform single-phase BCC structure
Uniform BCC structure enhances high-temperature yield strength
Dislocation mechanism transition (screw to edge) maintains strength at elevated temperature
The cited HfMoNbTaW alloy system is directly analogous to TiVNbTa
